name: Circuit
author: E. T. Carter
description: A printed circuit board under raking light: parallel copper bundles jog at 45 degrees across a solder-mask ground with the fibreglass weave showing through, ending in rows of tinned through-hole pads with drill holes, vias and silkscreened footprints. The bottom layer ghosts through the laminate while pulses of light race along the traces with comet tails.

params.label: Pitch
params.effect: Trace pitch in CSS pixels; low is a dense fine-pitch board, high is a chunky hobby board.

params.label: Pulse speed
params.effect: How fast the light pulses travel along the traces; 0 freezes them in place.

params.label: Routing density
params.effect: Fraction of lanes that carry a trace bundle; the rest hold SMD footprints or bare mask.

params.label: Pulse glow
params.effect: Brightness of the travelling pulses and their halo on the mask; 0 is an unpowered board.

params.label: Weave
params.effect: Visibility of the fibreglass weave and mask mottle in the ground; 0 is a flat matte mask.
